record.reason: The primary abstract surveys local and global explainability methods for LLMs, organized by fine-tuning and prompting paradigms, and discusses explanation metrics and challenges. It is interpretability research, not an LLM inference/serving system or an inference-time compression/efficiency technique.
record.title: Explainability for Large Language Models: A Survey
